heroHeadline: "DtMF" Extends All-Time Hot Latin Songs Record to 59 Weeks at No. 1 — European Stadiums Open in 6 Days in Barcelona
heroSubtitle: The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart dated May 16, 2026 marks 'DtMF' at its 59th consecutive week at No. 1 — extending the all-time chart record Bad Bunny first broke on May 2 (57 weeks, surpassing 'Despacito'). At nearly 14 months at the top, the song is the longest No. 1 run in the chart's 60+ year history and continues to add weeks each Saturday. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour's European stadium leg opens in six days at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (May 22–23, sold out), Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years, before moving to Lisbon, Madrid (10 shows at Riyadh Air Metropolitano — the most shows by any act at a single venue on one tour in Spanish history), Düsseldorf, Arnhem, London, Paris, Stockholm, Warsaw, Milan, and Brussels through July 22. The Bad Bunny x Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (Vivid Red, KI7916, $120) — which launched yesterday May 15 at All The Right boutique in NYC — hits wide release via Adidas Confirmed on May 30. Director Residente's Deadline interview confirmed *Porto Rico* principal photography expected to begin late 2026 in Puerto Rico, with Bad Bunny leading as revolutionary José Maldonado Román alongside Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem, executive produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu.
